## Problem 1

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(1)

birthday_match = function(n) {
  birthdays = sample(1:365, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  any(duplicated(birthdays))
}

birthday_results =
  expand_grid(
    group_size = 2:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |>
  mutate(
    shared_birthday = map_lgl(group_size, birthday_match)
  ) |>
  group_by(group_size) |>
  summarize(
    probability = mean(shared_birthday)
  )

birthday_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group_size, y = probability)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Group Size",
    y = "Probability of Shared Birthday"
  )
```

The probability of sharing a birthday increases as the group size increases. With around 23 people, the probability is about 50%. By 50 people, the probability is approximately 97%.
